_comment: Companies whose own careers pages find_jobs.py -s careers reads (scripts/vendor/fetch_careers.py, from job-scan). Platform is detected from the URL or the note. Checked 2026-10-24. The Volvo URLs are filtered to Sweden (their unfiltered pages are global); change locationsearch for EU searches in 2027. 'browser_only' pages render jobs with JavaScript or block scripts: open them in the user's Chrome when a broad search is wanted. Saab, FMV, FOI and other restricted employers are left out on purpose (clearance gate).
